title: Join us for the PanKbase Webinar October 22, 2026
bodyHtml:
Join us for the next PanKbase Office Hours:


? PanKgraph: Trustworthy Natural Language Search for T1D and Pancreas Research
? Thursday, October 22, 2026
⏰ 12:00–1:00 PM ET
?️ Featured speaker: Yiqun Wang

Topics we will cover:

  1. Ask biological questions in plain language: Search connected T1D and pancreas resources without writing database queries.
  2. Trace answers to supporting evidence: See how structured knowledge, source provenance, and controlled AI workflows support reliable interpretation.
  3. Explore research examples: Connect T1D genetic associations to candidate genes and identify HPAP donors and samples for specific study criteria.

? Register for the event
summary: Yiqun Wang will present "PanKgraph: Trustworthy Natural Language Search for T1D and Pancreas Research."
